title: The use of Bone Allograft material and Enamel matrix derivates in the regenerative treatment of mandibular furcation class II defects in localised periodontitis with trauma from occlusion: a report of two cases and a narrative review of the literature Solakoglu Ö
authors: Amiri N, Ahlers MO. Dtsch Zahnärztl Z Int 2021 Mar;3:8 –110. doi: 10.3238/dzz-int.2021.0012.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Successful regeneration of periodontal tissues can be achieved using the combination of guided tissue regeneration (GTR), Allograft bone substitute, Emdogain and plasma rich in growth factor (PRGF). The combination therapy resulted in regeneration of tooth supporting tissue with improved clinical attachment levels and healthy gingiva” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
